title: Living Scenarios: real Forge ingestion benchmark
recordType: Curated summary of an existing staging benchmark; not a new run
environment: Forge staging environment on a Jira Cloud free-plan test site, driven by the actual CLI from WSL2 in California
findings: Forge SQL rejected large derived-table updates that succeeded in local TiDB; bounding those updates to 100 rows resolved the observed finalization failure.
Jira bulk property updates required completion polling before the next write.
The final result batch met its 20-second handler budget but exceeded the tighter 5-second per-batch target.
limitations: Generated workload on a test site, not customer traffic.
In-Jira panel latency, rendering, SQL request counts, and actual platform compute costs were not measured by this benchmark.
The app remains unreleased to the marketplace.
